claims.quote: Overall, our study identified six SNP-related biomarkers (IQGAP2, HHAT, FGF14, CTNNA3, GRIA3, and NRXN1) associated with AD.
The biomarker-transcription factor (TF) network indicated that Cispb M4676 regulates IQGAP2, NRXN1, GRIA3 and FGF14.
Functional enrichment and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) linked these biomarkers to pathways such as carboxylic acid catabolic process, exocytic vesicle membrane, and carbon metabolism.
